question: How many individuals were conferred the Padma Awards in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 4 (139)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Padma Awards** are one of the highest civilian honors in India. They are announced annually on the occasion of **Republic Day**.
 
• In the year **2025**, a total of **139 individuals** were conferred with the Padma Awards. *Hence, option 4 is correct.*
 
• The Padma Awards are divided into three categories: **Padma Vibhushan** (for exceptional and distinguished service), **Padma Bhushan** (distinguished service of higher order), and **Padma Shri** (distinguished service).
 
• The awards recognize achievements in various disciplines such as **art, literature, education, sports, medicine, social work, science and engineering, public affairs, civil service, trade and industry**, and more.
 
• The recipients of the Padma Awards are announced every year in January, and the awards are distributed by the **President of India** at ceremonial functions he
